subtopic: Matching Investment Risk to Your Goals
source_evidence: Before you make any investment, understand the risks of the investment and make sure the risks are appropriate for you.
answer: When choosing investments for a goal, such as retirement or college savings, consider whether each investment’s risks are appropriate for you. Stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and ETFs are common asset categories, and other categories may have risks specific to them. Understand an investment’s risks and fees before investing; don’t choose an option based on the goal alone.
